meta.title: Art du Rendez-Vous Café — Café & bar in Laeken, Brussels
meta.description: Coffee, Belgian beers, aperitifs and spirits at Rue des Artistes 1A, Laeken. Open every day, 24 hours at weekends.
day.title: From the first espresso to the last Orval.
day.body: Mornings, a coffee on the way to Bockstael. Evenings, a Spritz on the terrace. Nights, a Trappist at the bar. At weekends we never close.

order.body: Coming soon: our voice and chat assistant answers in French or English, knows the whole menu and takes your pickup order. Scan the QR code at your table to start.
